title: Learning Latency-Aware Orchestration for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2601.10560v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) coordinate multiple LLM-powered agents through structured workflows, gaining reasoning power but incurring high inference latency from multi-step execution and repeated model invocations. Existing orchestration methods primarily optimize task performance and inference cost, leaving latency largely unaddressed. In MAS, end-to-end latency is governed by the \textit{critical execution path}, so reducing total cost alone does not reliably reduce latency. Moreover, optimizing latency while preserving accuracy remains non-trivial: naive latency optimization can misassign operator-level credit and degrade task accuracy. translated_title: 面向多智能体系统的延迟感知编排学习
translated_abstract: 多智能体系统（MAS）通过结构化工作流协调多个基于LLM的智能体，从而获得推理能力，但多步执行和重复模型调用导致高推理延迟。现有编排方法主要优化任务性能和推理成本，而延迟问题在很大程度上未被解决。在MAS中，端到端延迟由关键执行路径决定，因此仅降低总成本并不能可靠地减少延迟。此外，在保持准确性的同时优化延迟仍非易事：朴素的延迟优化可能错误分配操作级信用并降低任务准确性。为解决这一缺口，我们提出了延迟感知多智能体系统（LAMaS），这是一个面向基于学习的多智能体系统的延迟感知编排框架。LAMaS在两个层面解决这一挑战：在训练时，它学习延迟感知策略；在推理时，它动态调整执行路径以最小化延迟，同时保持任务准确性。
tldr: 本文提出LAMaS框架，通过训练时学习延迟感知策略和推理时动态调整执行路径，在不牺牲任务准确性的前提下优化多智能体系统的端到端延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LAMaS, a latency-aware orchestration framework that optimizes end-to-end latency in multi-agent systems by learning latency-aware policies at training time and dynamically adjusting execution paths at inference time, without sacrificing task accuracy.
